one_liner_zh: Sempra公佈最新季度財報，受惠於基礎建設穩定成長，EPS達1.16美元優於市場預期。
one_liner_en: Sempra reported quarterly EPS of $1.16, beating analyst estimates driven by stable infrastructure growth.
beat_or_miss: 超預期，EPS達1.16美元高於預估的1.06美元
highlights_zh: 每股盈餘（EPS）為1.16美元，超出市場預期的1.06美元。
公用事業本業營運穩健，資本支出計畫持續推進。
財務結構維持健全，支撐長期股利政策。
highlights_en: EPS of $1.16 outperformed the consensus estimate of $1.06.
Core utility operations remained solid with ongoing capital expenditure execution.
Maintained a healthy financial structure supporting long-term dividend policies.
risks_zh: 營收較去年同期微幅下滑0.10%，成長動能受限。
利率變動可能影響公用事業的融資成本與評價。
risks_en: Quarterly revenue saw a slight year-over-year decline of 0.10%, indicating limited top-line momentum.
Fluctuating interest rates could impact financing costs and utility valuations.
ai_view_zh: 觀點：財報優於預期展現防禦型類股的韌性。對中短期股價呈中性偏多，因獲利品質穩定但營收成長有限。需追蹤監管機構費率核准進度及資本支出執行率。
ai_view_en: View: Earnings beat demonstrates defensive sector resilience. Neutral-to-positive near-to-mid term implications given stable earnings quality despite flat top-line growth. Track regulatory rate case outcomes and capital expenditure execution rates.
